title: Designing in the Dark Without Losing the Thread
excerpt: A short note on keeping a sharp editorial workflow inside a dramatic visual system.
body: Dark interfaces work best when hierarchy is crisp. The Porto resume style uses strong section contrast, compact metadata, and a clean accent color, so the writing gets a frame without disappearing into decoration.
author: Franco Robles

title: Why This Blog Starts on the Server
excerpt: Server rendering gives the first view real content, then React takes over for the writing flow.
body: The page is rendered on the server with the current posts already in place. Once the browser hydrates, creating a new post feels immediate while the API persists the content to a JSON file.
author: Franco Robles
